title: All four checks must pass before committing
context: The repository has four orthogonal verification steps: build (with tsc), tests (vitest + cargo test), lint (ESLint + clippy + comment density), and format (Prettier + rustfmt). Each catches different classes of problems.
decision: Every commit and every pull request must pass all four checks with no exceptions and no advisory options. One command, `pnpm verify`, runs all of them in order. This is non-negotiable.
consequences: Developers must run full `pnpm verify` before pushing, taking ~33 seconds. A faster inner-loop command `pnpm verify:fast` exists but skips bundling, which means it cannot catch missing vite.config.ts entries, unresolved assets, or bad dynamic imports that type-check.
